You're within the 30-day window (day 12), and an unused pot in its original packaging is eligible for a change-of-mind return. Since you're not a Leafy Plus member, a flat **$6.95** return fee is deducted from your refund, so you'd get back **$27.05** of the $34 pot price.

Original shipping isn't refunded for change-of-mind returns, since that only applies when the whole order is returned because of our error. Start the return from "My Orders" and drop the parcel off within **7 days** of receiving the prepaid label. Your refund will be issued to your original payment method within **5 business days** of the pot reaching our warehouse.
